    <style>
        /* ============ Company 360 - self-contained styles (c360- prefix, no collisions) ============ */
        .c360-wrap{--c-ink:#16243a;--c-mut:#64748b;--c-faint:#94a3b8;--c-line:#e5eaf0;--c-bg:#f8fafc;
            --c-good:#2e7d54;--c-goodbg:#f0f9f4;--c-warn:#a3722a;--c-warnbg:#fdf8ef;--c-risk:#a8504f;--c-riskbg:#fcf3f3;
            --c-acc:#2563eb;--c-accbg:#eff6ff;}
        .c360-wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 40px;}
        .c360-sec{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.05);}
        .c360-sh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--c-line);background:#fbfcfe;}
        .c360-sh .num{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--c-faint);letter-spacing:.08em;}
        .c360-sh .ic{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--c-accbg);color:var(--c-acc);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;flex:0 0 auto;}
        .c360-sh h2{margin:0;font-size:15px;font-weight:650;color:var(--c-ink);letter-spacing:-.2px;}
        .c360-sh .hint{margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;color:var(--c-faint);}
        .c360-sb{padding:18px 20px;}

        /* hero */
        .c360-hero{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;align-items:center;}
        .c360-gauge{width:150px;flex:0 0 auto;text-align:center;}
        .c360-gauge .n{font-size:40px;font-weight:700;color:var(--c-ink);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-1px;}
        .c360-gauge .n small{font-size:15px;color:var(--c-faint);font-weight:500;}
        .c360-gauge .l{font-size:11px;color:var(--c-mut);margin-top:4px;}
        .c360-hero-txt{flex:1;min-width:260px;font-size:13.5px;color:#3c4a5d;line-height:1.7;}
        .c360-band{display:inline-block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:650;padding:3px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;}
        .c360-band.good{background:var(--c-goodbg);color:var(--c-good);border-color:#d3ecdf;}
        .c360-band.warn{background:var(--c-warnbg);color:var(--c-warn);border-color:#f1e2c6;}
        .c360-band.risk{background:var(--c-riskbg);color:var(--c-risk);border-color:#f0d7d7;}
        .c360-band.nodata{background:#f6f8fa;color:#7b8794;border-color:var(--c-line);}

        /* gauge meters (investing-style dials) */
        .c360-gaugerow{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-around;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:6px 0 2px;}
        .c360-gaugebox{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;width:200px;}
        .c360-gaugebox.big{width:300px;}
        .c360-gaugebox .gl{font-size:13px;font-weight:650;color:var(--c-ink);text-decoration:none;margin-bottom:2px;}
        .c360-gaugebox.big .gl{font-size:14px;}
        .c360-gaugebox .gl:hover{color:var(--c-acc);}
        .c360-gaugebox .gsvg{width:170px;height:auto;display:block;}
        .c360-gaugebox.big .gsvg{width:260px;}
        .c360-gaugebox .gtx{font-size:10px;fill:#8a96a6;font-family:inherit;}
        .gpill{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;padding:5px 18px;border-radius:999px;}
        .gpill.g-strong{background:#e6f4ea;color:#1b7d3e;}
        .gpill.g-good{background:#f0f9f4;color:#2e7d54;}
        .gpill.g-neutral{background:#57606a;color:#fff;}
        .gpill.g-weak{background:#fdecea;color:#c0392b;}
        .gpill.g-risky{background:#c62828;color:#fff;}
        @media(max-width:680px){.c360-gaugerow{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}.c360-gaugebox{order:2;}.c360-gaugebox.big{order:1;}}

        /* score strip */
        .c360-scores{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;}
        @media(max-width:1000px){.c360-scores{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
        @media(max-width:540px){.c360-scores{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
        .c360-score{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;position:relative;}
        .c360-score::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:14px;right:14px;height:2px;border-radius:0 0 2px 2px;background:#cbd5e1;}
        .c360-score.good::before{background:#34a06a;}.c360-score.warn::before{background:#d49a43;}.c360-score.risk::before{background:#cd6868;}
        .c360-score .hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;}
        .c360-score .hd i{color:var(--c-mut);font-size:12px;}
        .c360-score .hd b{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#2c3a4b;}
        .c360-score .val{font-size:26px;font-weight:650;color:var(--c-ink);line-height:1;}
        .c360-score .val small{font-size:12px;color:var(--c-faint);font-weight:400;}
        .c360-score .track{height:5px;border-radius:999px;background:#eef2f6;margin:9px 0 7px;overflow:hidden;}
        .c360-score .fill{height:100%;border-radius:999px;background:#94a3b8;}
        .c360-score.good .fill{background:#57b287;}.c360-score.warn .fill{background:#ddb06a;}.c360-score.risk .fill{background:#d98c8c;}
        .c360-score .nt{font-size:11px;color:var(--c-mut);line-height:1.5;}

        /* snapshot */
        .c360-kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--c-line);border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;}
        @media(max-width:800px){.c360-kv{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
        .c360-kv .cell{background:#fff;padding:11px 14px;}
        .c360-kv .k{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--c-faint);}
        .c360-kv .v{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:550;color:var(--c-ink);margin-top:3px;word-break:break-word;}

        /* tables */
        .c360-t{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px;}
        .c360-t th{text-align:left;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--c-faint);font-weight:600;padding:9px 12px;background:#fbfcfe;border-bottom:1px solid var(--c-line);white-space:nowrap;}
        .c360-t td{padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;color:#3c4a5d;}
        .c360-t tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0;}
        .c360-t tr:hover{background:var(--c-bg);}
        .c360-t .num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap;}

        /* why-lists, flags */
        .c360-why{margin:8px 0 0;padding-left:17px;}
        .c360-why li{font-size:12px;color:#5b6776;margin-bottom:5px;line-height:1.55;}
        .c360-flags{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
        .c360-flag{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:12.5px;color:#3c4a5d;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-left-width:3px;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;line-height:1.5;}
        .c360-flag.good{border-left-color:#34a06a;}.c360-flag.warn{border-left-color:#d49a43;}
        .c360-flag.risk{border-left-color:#cd6868;}.c360-flag.info{border-left-color:#7ba7e0;}
        .c360-flag i{margin-top:2px;font-size:11px;color:var(--c-mut);}
        .c360-cols2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;}
        @media(max-width:800px){.c360-cols2{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

        /* verdict cards */
        .c360-verdicts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;}
        @media(max-width:900px){.c360-verdicts{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
        .c360-verd{border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;background:#fff;}
        .c360-verd .aud{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:650;color:var(--c-ink);margin-bottom:10px;}
        .c360-verd .aud i{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--c-accbg);color:var(--c-acc);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;}
        .c360-verd .rec{font-size:14px;font-weight:650;margin:6px 0 2px;}
        .c360-verd .rec.good{color:var(--c-good);}.c360-verd .rec.warn{color:var(--c-warn);}.c360-verd .rec.risk{color:var(--c-risk);}
        .c360-verd .sm{font-size:11px;color:var(--c-mut);margin-bottom:8px;}
        .c360-verd ul{margin:0;padding-left:16px;}
        .c360-verd li{font-size:11.5px;color:#5b6776;margin-bottom:4px;line-height:1.5;}

        /* timeline */
        .c360-tl{position:relative;padding-left:22px;}
        .c360-tl::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:7px;top:4px;bottom:4px;width:2px;background:#e8eef5;border-radius:2px;}
        .c360-tli{position:relative;padding:0 0 16px 12px;}
        .c360-tli::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-19px;top:4px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:2px solid #9db4d0;}
        .c360-tli.charge::before{border-color:#d49a43;}
        .c360-tli.incorporation::before{border-color:#34a06a;}
        .c360-tli .d{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--c-faint);font-weight:600;}
        .c360-tli .t{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--c-ink);margin:1px 0;}
        .c360-tli .x{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--c-mut);}

        /* directors */
        .c360-dirgrid a{color:var(--c-acc);text-decoration:none;}

        /* charts */
        .c360-charts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;}
        @media(max-width:860px){.c360-charts{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
        .c360-chartbox{border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;}
        .c360-chartbox h4{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#2c3a4b;}
        .c360-chartbox .host{height:230px;position:relative;}

        /* lock teaser */
        .c360-lock{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;}
        .c360-lock .blur{filter:blur(6px);user-select:none;pointer-events:none;opacity:.85;}
        .c360-lock .cta{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);}
        .c360-lock .cta p{margin:0;font-size:12.5px;color:#3c4a5d;font-weight:550;}
        .c360-lock .cta a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--c-ink);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 22px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;}

        /* insights */
        .c360-ins{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
        @media(max-width:800px){.c360-ins{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
        .c360-ins .one{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:12.5px;color:#3c4a5d;line-height:1.55;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--c-bg);border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-radius:8px;}
        .c360-ins .one i{color:var(--c-acc);margin-top:2px;font-size:11px;}

        .c360-peerlist a{color:var(--c-acc);text-decoration:none;}
        .c360-note{font-size:11px;color:var(--c-faint);margin-top:12px;line-height:1.55;}
        .c360-disclaimer{margin:22px 0 6px;padding:14px 18px;background:var(--c-bg);border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-radius:10px;font-size:11.5px;color:#7b8794;line-height:1.6;}
        .c360-empty{padding:18px;text-align:center;color:var(--c-faint);font-size:12.5px;}

        /* blurred dummy values for non-paying visitors (real figures never enter the HTML) */
        .c360-blurval{filter:blur(5px);user-select:none;pointer-events:none;opacity:.8;display:inline-block;}
        .c360-unlockline{margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;color:#5b6776;}
        .c360-unlockline a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:var(--c-ink);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 16px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;margin-left:8px;}

        /* who-uses-this cards */
        .c360-uses{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;}
        @media(max-width:760px){.c360-uses{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
        .c360-use{border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;background:#fff;}
        .c360-use .uh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:650;color:var(--c-ink);margin-bottom:7px;}
        .c360-use .uh i{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--c-accbg);color:var(--c-acc);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;}
        .c360-use p{margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#5b6776;line-height:1.6;}

        /* visible FAQ accordion */
        .c360-faq-item{border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-radius:9px;margin-bottom:8px;background:#fff;}
        .c360-faq-item summary{cursor:pointer;padding:11px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--c-ink);list-style:none;}
        .c360-faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
        .c360-faq-item summary::before{content:"+";display:inline-block;width:16px;color:var(--c-acc);font-weight:700;}
        .c360-faq-item[open] summary::before{content:"\2212";}

<script>
(function () {
    var services = document.querySelector('.services-dropdown-container:not(.products-dropdown-container)');
    var products = document.querySelector('.products-dropdown-container');
    if (!services && !products) return;

    function close(el) { if (el) el.classList.remove('active'); }
    function open(el)  { if (el) el.classList.add('active'); }

    function bind(self, other) {
        if (!self) return;
        var menu = self.querySelector('.services-dropdown-menu');
        var toggle = self.querySelector('.services-dropdown-toggle');

        // Hover on the toggle (or the menu itself) opens self, closes other.
        function onEnter() { close(other); open(self); }
        function onLeave() {
            // Wait a beat so a quick gap between toggle and menu is forgiven.
            setTimeout(function () {
                // Only close if the cursor is no longer over either the
                // container itself or the menu it owns.
                if (!self.matches(':hover') && (!menu || !menu.matches(':hover'))) {
                    close(self);
                }
            }, 180);
        }

        self.addEventListener('mouseenter', onEnter);
        self.addEventListener('mouseleave', onLeave);
        if (menu) {
            menu.addEventListener('mouseenter', onEnter);
            menu.addEventListener('mouseleave', onLeave);
        }

        if (toggle) {
            toggle.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                // Products toggle has href="/products" - let it navigate normally
                // unless the dropdown is already closed. For Services href="#"
                // we always cancel.
                if (toggle.getAttribute('href') === '#') e.preventDefault();
                close(other);
                self.classList.toggle('active');
            });
        }
    }
    bind(services, products);
    bind(products, services);

    // Outside-click closes both.
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.services-dropdown-container, .products-dropdown-container')) {
            close(services);
            close(products);
        }
    });

    // Esc closes both.
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.keyCode === 27) {
            close(services);
            close(products);
        }
    });

    // User avatar dropdown - click to toggle (handles mobile / no-hover devices).
    // Hover behaviour still works through the existing CSS rule.
    var userMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-layout .user-menu-container');
    var userToggle = document.getElementById('userMenuToggle');
    if (userMenu && userToggle) {
        userToggle.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            userMenu.classList.toggle('active');
        });
        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (!e.target.closest('.user-menu-container')) {
                userMenu.classList.remove('active');
            }
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.keyCode === 27) {
                userMenu.classList.remove('active');
            }
        });
    }
})();
</script>

<script>
    (function() {
        function isMobileDevice() {
            return window.innerWidth <= 768;
        }

        function initMobileSearch() {
            if (!isMobileDevice()) {
                const mobileToggle = document.getElementById('mobileSearchToggle');
                if (mobileToggle) {
                    mobileToggle.style.display = 'none';
                }
                const searchContainer = document.getElementById('mobileSearchContainer');
                if (searchContainer) {
                    searchContainer.style.display = '';
                    searchContainer.classList.remove('mobile-search-active');
                }
                return;
            }

            const mobileToggle = document.getElementById('mobileSearchToggle');
            const searchContainer = document.getElementById('mobileSearchContainer');

            if (!mobileToggle || !searchContainer) return;

            mobileToggle.style.display = 'flex';

            mobileToggle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                const isActive = searchContainer.classList.contains('mobile-search-active');

                if (isActive) {
                    searchContainer.classList.remove('mobile-search-active');
                    mobileToggle.classList.remove('active');
                    const searchInput = searchContainer.querySelector('input');
                    if (searchInput && document.activeElement === searchInput) {
                        searchInput.blur();
                    }
                } else {
                    searchContainer.classList.add('mobile-search-active');
                    mobileToggle.classList.add('active');
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        const searchInput = searchContainer.querySelector('input');
                        if (searchInput) {
                            searchInput.focus();
                        }
                    }, 100);
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (searchContainer.classList.contains('mobile-search-active')) {
                    if (!searchContainer.contains(e.target) && !mobileToggle.contains(e.target)) {
                        searchContainer.classList.remove('mobile-search-active');

                    if (searchInput) {
                        searchInput.blur();
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initMobileSearch);
        } else {
            initMobileSearch();
        }

        let resizeTimeout;
        window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
            clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
            resizeTimeout = setTimeout(initMobileSearch, 150);
        });
    })();

                if (st) st.textContent = 'Connection restored';
                setTimeout(function () { box.style.display = 'none'; }, 600);

            window.addEventListener('online', hide);
